description: AI-powered presentation and document generator — create pitch decks, proposals, infographics, websites, and ebooks from text prompts or URLs.

/auth.description: Authentication page for Login, Signup, and Password Reset.

/tools/prompt-to-deck.description: Generate a slide deck from a text prompt or uploaded file.

/editor.description: Slide editor where generated presentations or templates can be customized.

/account.description: User account settings and subscription management.

/templates.description: Browse and select starter templates for various document types.

/presentation/outline.description: Outline review page to rearrange, edit, add, or generate text and images for slides before full presentation generation.

edit_outline: Used when user wants to modify an outline element directly
Executes in the outline view context
edit_slide: Used when user wants to modify an existing slide element directly (title, text, shape, etc.)
create_presentation: Enter a description / prompt into the text area
Select desired goal, tone, visual style, and slide count
Upload a source file if needed
Wait for AI generation sequence to complete
Presentation will automatically load in Editor or preview
open_editor: Interact with editor canvas to select slide elements
manage_account: Use tabs to view Subscription Details or Account Settings
